traits.name: Artificer's Lore
traits.desc: When you make an Intelligence (History) check related to magic items, alchemical objects, or technological devices, you add twice your Proficiency Bonus.

traits.name: Tinker
traits.desc: You have proficiency with Artisan's Tools; with 1 hour and some small materials, you can build a Tiny clockwork device (a toy, fire starter, or music box).
